articles.title: Dana Corrigan, 94, Neighborhood Baker
articles.deck: Friends remember Dana Corrigan for the many years of service to Foxglove Heights.
body: Born in Foxglove Heights in the years after the war, Dana Corrigan spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Dana Corrigan died in October at home on Union Lane, at the age of 94.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co. in his or her name.
